reasoning: A play button inside stacked squares is the standard icon for a video library, playlist, or collection of clips (familiar from YouTube's Library/Subscriptions tab). It fits tasks about watching a series/course, curating playlists, or managing video files, though at a quick glance it blends with a single video play icon.
